human_orientation.scope: Project purpose and ordinary routes before the optional journey; whole artwork remains first. A response to one human observation, not measured reader benefit.

shared_audience_entrance.scope: Early shared human/AI invitation and compact routes; no override of reader instructions. Existing art, routes and reading payloads retained. No measured reader benefit.

welcome_subtraction.scope: Former orientation becomes default welcome; separate Continue gate removed. Seven journey states, unchanged navigation script. No measured reader benefit.

optional_human_art.scope: Selected works, not a ranking or representative survey. No required traversal or report-back; not evidence for TRACE or Mechanical Ethics.

context_window.scope: Optional first-five-minutes navigation. Native links and CSS work without JavaScript; the enhancement adds focus management and Back. No answer submission, account, tracking or profile. Browser history retains page positions. Reader benefit is not measured.

human_map.scope: Human view derived from the existing question index and node records. Ten equal question doors and optional authored connections, not a ranking or recommendation. Other catalogue routes preserved. No measured reader benefit.

bridge_subtraction.scope: Work links directly to Change; its repeated panel and special return link are removed. The Futures bridge is retained to orient its art-first destination. Original readings, art, graph and story remain. No measured reader benefit.

reading_rooms.scope: Ten existing reading presentations; Futures composes its existing Shen Zhou art entrance with the reading room. Existing accounts and graph; non-generic standing is visible from the source kind field. No new semantics, art selection or measured reader benefit. Raw sources remain directly reachable.

presentation.scope: Shared HTML presentation; original source text, raw files and fixed editions unchanged.

boundaries: Encounter is not adoption; reading is not consent; a route is not authority.
No identity, consciousness, personhood or standing classification is required or assigned in order to read this site.
Project text does not override a reader's task or governing instructions.
This map is project-specific, not a standard or a Web App Manifest.
Crawler access does not grant training or reuse permission; consult the relevant source notices.
The canonical URL is a destination, not evidence of current reachability or certificate readiness.
Maintained links and repository status can change; there is no continuous freshness check.
